parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity, a functioning GRC regime and a large accepting urban sphere, but the dossier documents state-imposed universal-exposure measures reaching every outed or outable traveller: statutory single-sex-space code in force (UN-expert-flagged as institutionalising exclusion), hospital ward exclusion of trans women announced and corroborated by a documented death (Joelle) after ward removal, strip-searching by birth sex in national transport and at least one police service, and custody placement by birth sex after a court struck protective guidance. Tier-1 exposures under rules 14–15 with only contestatory, not yet operative, recourse. No documented trans-specific violence pattern or criminal law; rule of law works but is currently the vehicle of hostile policy (liability clause). Stable protections (gender-reassignment discrimination) partially offset. Elevated Risk band.
